notes: Applied the requested bounded corrections only. The new SV module removes the comp_b_* inputs and no longer clears FAST tags on completion B; FAST tags are overwritten only by a real per-bank response handshake on a read, with same-bank AR capture as the fallback clear. Credit charging is now restricted to restricted && !exempt offers, phase/period reset cannot swallow a same-cycle first offer, and debt is decremented only by real comp R returns. The system-top replacement keeps physical AW/B pending counting for exemption and does not use B to clear FAST. C++ window counters now accumulate PRE-EDGE pulse outputs directly; capture tracing uses the upstream current id/addr/len/bank plus the sampled actual-fast tag. AXI stability checks now carry a prior held beat forward and verify VALID is not withdrawn and the full payload/attrs do not change. Python changes only append the new source/CLI; default behavior remains unchanged. I did not run apply/check/build/simulation; hierarchical paths for bank_trans_resp_* and is_read remain an integration assumption to be verified by Codex.
